sources.title: Niroj Ranjan Misra, Forgotten Craft: Tribal Jewelry Makers of Odisha Struggle to Shine, The Indian Tribal,17August2025
sources.locator: Body paragraphs beginning For over two decades; In villages like; The jewelry-making process; With the help; Artisans like; web lines138–159
sources.inspection: actual original content read (historical transcription where specified)
claims: Report explicitly identifies most artisan families in Soura Kuhudi, Ghansuli and Badapada as Sunari.
Named artisan Pinku Sorabu learned from his father Nanda Kishore and reports working with mother Subarna, wife Droupadi and sister Girija.
Report places their jewellery making in relationships with Bhotara customers and increasingly non-tribal customers.

limits: This is dated named reporting, not a community census; field interview date not separately specified.
Identify the context as families described in the report; do not infer caste from Sorabu surname alone.

Avoid dubious price units/gold quote, precise earnings comparisons, awkward tool translations and medical claims.
Photos are not cleared for republication.
